title: Talk to the Biographer
intro: Your story starts with a conversation.
description: Share memories by speaking or writing. Add photographs and turn meaningful moments into a book.
privacy: Your conversations and original recordings are saved privately. Review them and continue another day.
consent: I agree to save my conversations and recordings for this book.
unavailable: The Biographer is not available yet. Please try again later.
failed: This change could not be saved. Please keep this page open and try again.
signIn: Sign in to start or continue your private conversation.
avatarIntro: Start talking to meet your biographer. Your camera stays off.
awakeHelp: Keep this page open while talking. Your device may still pause the conversation.
firstQuestion: Who would you like this book to be about?
skipText: I would like to skip this question.
reviewHelp: Review your memories, correct a transcript or decide what belongs in your book.
excluded: Excluded from future interviews and book proposals.
bookHeading: Find the shape of your book
bookHelp: Mythoria proposes a title and chapters from your saved memories. Your narrator persona guides the story.
proposalReview: Review this direction before creating your book. Gathering more memories creates a new proposal.
connectionLost: The connection stopped. Saved material is safe. Start talking when you are ready to resume.
playback: Tap the video to enable playback.
photoCaption: What does this photograph remind you of?

save.local: Saved on this device; waiting to upload
save.attention: Some audio still needs saving. Keep this page open.

researchHelp: Confirm only public places and periods. Private memories and names are not sent to web search.
localRecordingHelp: Audio stays on this device until it can be uploaded. Keep this page open and stop when finished.
omittedMemories: Memories not included in this proposal
refreshDirection: Create a new proposal to apply these choices.
